policy: Decision record only. Nothing here deletes or moves anything; ARCHIVE marks a path retained for provenance rather than routine use, and no evidence is deleted without a separate review.

review_methods.static-review: The comparison was read from the cited files by the reviewing agent. It is neither mechanically enforced nor attributed to a human reviewer; only the path and link properties of a paired runbook are checked by a validator.
review_methods.inventory-source-review: Observed by reading: section responsibilities and page headings/indexes; application entrypoints and build manifests; lab classification reasons and capture limitations; Golden gate registry/workflow bindings; retained digest registry/checker. Agent review supplies group reasons; git enumeration supplies members only. This is not an exhaustive factual/semantic review of every leaf, a human review, Azure re-execution or authorization to delete. Unresolved lifecycle questions remain conservative KEEP.

coverage_note: Complete tracked-tree membership snapshot, reviewed offline. Each root file and occupied top-level/depth-two directory has an explicit record, with deeper lifecycle groups and selected overrides. Longest explicit path wins; directory members are exact relative paths assigned only to that winner, not recursive permission for future children. Empty parent member lists mean all descendants have more-specific records. Additions, removals and renames require deliberate review and member edits; CI checks but never regenerates the snapshot. KEEP conservatively retains content and does not certify factual accuracy, Azure execution, evidence trust or final Golden review.
delete_count_note: No path is marked DELETE. Nothing measured in this audit justified destruction over archival. The single REWRITE finding was resolved by wiring the orphaned validator into CI rather than by removing it.
